title: Tiny, cute bell
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bellGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FFC107'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E6A800'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shineGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF8DC' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFF8DC' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- bell body -->
  <path d='M50 22
           C 32 22, 24 45, 24 58
           C 24 64, 27 66, 30 66
           L 70 66
           C 73 66, 76 64, 76 58
           C 76 45, 68 22, 50 22 Z'
        fill='url(#bellGrad)'/>

  <!-- bell base rim -->
  <rect x='22' y='62' width='56' height='8' rx='4' ry='4' fill='#E6A800'/>
  <rect x='22' y='62' width='56' height='3' rx='1.5' ry='1.5' fill='#FFD54F'/>

  <!-- top loop -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='4' fill='#E6A800'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='2.5' fill='none' stroke='#E6A800' stroke-width='2.5'/>

  <!-- clapper -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='73' r='5' fill='#D4A000'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='71' r='1.8' fill='#FFE066'/>

  <!-- shine highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='40' rx='8' ry='14' fill='url(#shineGrad)'/>

  <!-- cute face on bell -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='48' r='3.2' fill='#4A3000'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='3.2' fill='#4A3000'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='47' r='1.1' fill='#FFF8DC'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='47' r='1.1' fill='#FFF8DC'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 54 Q 50 60, 56 54' fill='none' stroke='#4A3000' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='53' r='3' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='53' r='3' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- little sparkles -->
  <path d='M72 30 L 73 33 L 76 34 L 73 35 L 72 38 L 71 35 L 68 34 L 71 33 Z' fill='#FFF8DC'/>
  <path d='M28 34 L 29 36.5 L 31.5 37.5 L 29 38.5 L 28 41 L 27 38.5 L 24.5 37.5 L 27 36.5 Z' fill='#FFF8DC'/>
</svg>
